findings.observation: Claimed nonuniqueness from two positive weights omits K>0. With K=0 and all weights positive, nonnegative rates are uniquely zero; stated witnesses coincide.
findings.impact: General conditional elementary lemma is false at zero aggregate. Both actual printed source totals are strictly positive, so saved arithmetic and applied non-identification examples are unaffected.
findings.minimal_correction: Use K>0 and w_a,w_b>0 for the nonuniqueness statement. At K=0 enforce r_i=0 for all w_i>0; zero-weight entries remain unobservable. See K_ZERO_LEMMA_CORRECTION_KO.md.
